units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) to quash the ruling and refer the case to the competent authority for consideration if, during consideration of the appeal, it is established that the ruling was issued by a judge, body or official lacking the requisite authority;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) to amend the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest, and to replace the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation imposed with another type of administrative penalty in accordance with the procedure specified in part 1.2 of Article 30.1 of this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) to leave unchanged the ruling in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code, or to amend that ruling provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom it was issued, and also to quash a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in another article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code concerning the same instance of unlawful actions (inaction), proceedings in which were conducted against the same person, and to terminate proceedings in that case in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A decision resulting from consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case must contain the information specified in part 1 of Article 29.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. When an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is considered, a procedural order referring the appeal to the competent authority for consideration shall be issued if it is established that its consideration falls outside the competence of that judge or official.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be announced immediately after it is issued.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. A decision on an appeal against a ruling in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code, considered by a higher body or higher-ranking official under the rules established by this chapter, shall be produced only as an electronic document using the information system (subsystem of a state information system) for pre-trial appeals used for information support of state control (supervision) and municipal control, established in accordance with Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 248-FZ “On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Within three days after it is issued, a copy of a decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be served on or sent to the individual or the legal entity’s statutory representative against whom the ruling in the case was issued, and to the victim if the victim lodged an appeal, or to the prosecutor at the prosecutor’s request.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: This paragraph was repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. - Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.8 · “This paragraph was repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. -…”

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2.1. Within three days after it is issued, a copy of a judge’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case considered by a judge shall be sent to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record and to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up such a record.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2.2. Within three days after it is issued, a copy of a judge’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case considered by a body or official shall be sent to the body or official that issued the ruling.
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. A decision on an appeal against a ruling imposing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be communicated to the body or official enforcing the ruling, as well as to the person in respect of whom the decision was issued and to the victim, on the day the decision is issued.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. Copies of the decision specified in point 7 of part 1 of Article 30.7 of this Code and of a decision amending or quashing a ruling in an administrative offence case specified in part 7 of Article 29.11 of this Code shall, no later than the day following the day the relevant decision enters into legal force, be sent to the judge or body to which the procedural order requesting the administrative offence case materials specified in part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code was sent, and to the body whose official forwarded the record of the administrative offence specified in Article 12.24 of this Code and the materials attached to it specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. The rule established by part 4 of this article shall apply when considering an appeal (protest) against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has entered into legal force, or against a decision on an appeal (protest) against such a ruling.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.8

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by an official and (or) a higher-ranking official’s decision on an appeal against that ruling may be appealed against to the court at the place where the appeal was considered, and then to a higher court.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a collegiate body or a body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and (or) a judge’s decision on an appeal against that ruling may be appealed against to a higher court.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Subsequent appeals against a ruling in an administrative offence case and (or) decisions on an appeal against that ruling shall be lodged, considered and determined in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by Articles 30.2 - 30.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. Copies of decisions shall be sent to the persons specified in Article 30.8 of this Code within three days of the decision being issued.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. In addition to the persons specified in part 1 of Article 30.1 of this Code, a court’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by an official may be appealed against by the body whose official issued that ruling.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. In addition to the persons specified in part 1 of Article 30.1 of this Code, a court’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a collegiate body or a body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may be appealed against by the head of the collegiate body or body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation that issued that ruling.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 30.9

units.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.text: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.label: Art. 30.10

units.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.label: Art. 30.10

units.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and (or) subsequent decisions of higher authorities on appeals against that ruling may be protested by a prosecutor in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by Articles 30.1 and 30.2 and parts 1 and 3 of Article 30.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.10

units.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.text: 2. A prosecutor’s protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and (or) subsequent decisions on appeals against that ruling shall be considered in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by Articles 30.4 - 30.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.10

units.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
units.text: 3. A copy of the decision on a prosecutor’s protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be sent to the prosecutor who lodged the protest and to the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 of this Code within three days after the decision is issued.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.10

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force may be appealed against by the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. A ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force may be protested by a prosecutor.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3. The right to lodge a protest belongs to prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and the Prosecutor General’s deputies, and, in respect of service members and citizens called up for military training, to prosecutors of military districts and fleets and equivalent prosecutors, the Chief Military Prosecutor and their deputies.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4. A decision that has entered into legal force and results from consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case may be appealed against by the head of the collegiate body that issued the ruling or by the body whose official issued the ruling in the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 5. A decision that has entered into legal force and results from consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a judge may be appealed against by the body whose official referred that case to the judge for consideration.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 6. A ruling that has entered into legal force in a case concerning an administrative offence in customs matters (a breach of customs rules) specified in chapter 16 of this Code, insofar as it imposes the administrative penalty of confiscation of the instrument used to commit or the object of the administrative offence (except where the administrative offence involves unlawful movement of goods across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union), and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests, may be appealed against by a person who owns that instrument or object, has not been held administratively liable for that administrative offence and has not been found guilty of committing it by a court, within ten days of the entry into legal force of the ruling in the administrative offence case or the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 7. If the time limit specified in part 6 of this article has been missed, it may, upon an application by the appellant, be restored by the judge authorised to consider the appeal. A procedural order shall be issued if that application is rejected.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 30.12

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. Appeals and protests shall be lodged with cassation courts of general jurisdiction, including the military cassation court, and with the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, except in the cases specified in part 1.1 of this article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1.1. Appeals and protests against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a justice of the peace that has entered into legal force, or a district court judge’s decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest against such a ruling, shall be lodged with the supreme courts of republics, territory and regional courts, courts of federal cities, the court of the autonomous region and courts of autonomous districts.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. The presidents of cassation courts of general jurisdiction, including the military cassation court, their deputies, or judges of those courts acting on the instructions of the president or the president’s deputies are authorised to review rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force and have been appealed or protested against in accordance with part 1 of this article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2.1. The presidents of the supreme courts of republics, territory and regional courts, courts of federal cities, the court of the autonomous region and courts of autonomous districts, their deputies, or judges of those courts acting on the instructions of the president or the president’s deputies are authorised to review rulings in administrative offence cases issued by justices of the peace and district court judges’ decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests against such rulings that have entered into legal force and have been appealed or protested against in accordance with part 1.1 of this article.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3. The President of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, the President’s deputies, or judges of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation acting on the instructions of its President or the President’s deputies shall consider appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force, if they have been considered in accordance with the procedure specified in part 2 or 2.1 of this article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4. Repealed. - Federal Law of 04.06.2014 No. 143-FZ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4.1. Decisions of arbitrazh courts in administrative offence cases and decisions adopted by them following consideration of appeals or protests (submissions) that have entered into legal force shall be reviewed by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation if all means of appealing against them in arbitrazh courts provided for by arbitrazh procedural legislation have been exhausted. Those decisions shall be reviewed by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation in accordance with the rules established by the Arbitrazh Procedure Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 5. Repealed. - Federal Law of 12.11.2018 No. 417-FZ.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.13

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.label: Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1. An appeal or protest shall be lodged with the court authorised to review such appeals or protests.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2. An appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force must contain:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1) the name of the court with which the appeal or protest is lodged;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 2) information about the appellant or the prosecutor lodging the protest;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3) information about the other participants in the administrative offence proceedings;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 4) identification of the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 5) the arguments of the appellant or the prosecutor lodging the protest, specifying the grounds for reviewing the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 6) a list of the materials attached to the appeal or protest;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 7) the signature of the appellant or the prosecutor lodging the protest.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 3. The following must be attached to the appeal or protest:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.14

units.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
units.text: 1) a copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 30.14
